# Fixture house rules

A small stand-in for the atlas's rules file. Every heading a packaged role cites is here.

## Principles

- Record only what the paper states, one value at a time.
- A fixture rule that no role file may repeat: zebras graze quietly beside the old river bank.

## Sources

- This section is cited by no role, so changing it moves no digest.

## Triage

- Include when the fixture paper reports a fixture finding about the gene.

| reason | use when |
|---|---|
| `other` | none of the fixture reasons fit |

Trailing paragraph of the triage section, with `code` and a trailing space.  

## Findings

- One finding per distinct fixture result.

### Variants

- One entry per variant, kept exactly as the paper prints it.

## Attribution and approval

- A fixture extractor is named `agent:<skill>/<model>`.

## Synthesis

- Cited by no role.
